snippet.title: NHL 2K7 - PS2 Gameplay (4K60fps)
snippet.description:
NHL 2K7 - PlayStation 2 Gameplay (4K60fps).

NHL 2K7 is an ice hockey video game made by 2K Sports. It was released on the PlayStation 3 in November 2006 and for the PlayStation 2, Xbox, and Xbox 360 in September 2006.
